However, they're subject to geographical restrictions, leaving creators in restricted countries without access. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy are alternative platforms that cater to digital sellers, but they have their own limitations and fees. How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal have strict geographical restrictions, blocking access to certain countries and regions. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy also impose their own restrictions, although less severe than Stripe and PayPal. Coremerch's sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, is designed to bypass these restrictions, providing a permanent solution for creators in restricted countries. Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal charge varying fees for payment processing, ranging from 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction to 4.4% + $0.30 per transaction. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy also impose their own fees, although generally lower than Stripe and PayPal. Coremerch's Edge Commerce Stack uses NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, with a 0.5% fee only. This results in significantly lower transaction fees compared to traditional payment processors, making it an attractive option for creators looking to minimize costs.

Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With automatic crypto payment verification and instant product delivery, creators can focus on growing their business without worrying about manual payment processing or product delivery.
